description: The Smith & Wesson First Response Folding Knife is a must-have tool for anyone looking for a reliable everyday carry (EDC) knife that excels in emergency situations. Built with a 3.3 inch 7Cr17 high carbon stainless steel blade, this tactical knife offers a razor-sharp edge that can handle any challenge. The 40% serrated drop point blade is perfect for piercing and cutting through tough materials. Designed with first responders in mind, the folding knife includes an integrated seat belt cutter and glass breaker, making it an essential tool for emergencies. The handle, crafted from durable stainless steel with a G10 inlay, ensures a secure grip and measures 4.7 inches for comfortable handling. The ambidextrous thumb plate allows for quick and easy blade deployment, whether you're left or right-handed. The steel liner lock keeps the blade securely open, preventing accidental closure during use. Compact enough to fit in a pocket, pouch, or clip onto tactical gear, the First Response Folding Knife is ready when you need it most.
